name: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power
description: Beginning in a time of relative peace, we follow an ensemble cast of characters as they confront the re-emergence of evil to Middle-earth. From the darkest depths of the Misty Mountains, to the majestic forests of Lindon, to the breathtaking island kingdom of Númenor, to the furthest reaches of the map, these kingdoms and characters will carve out legacies that live on long after they are gone.

videos.title: Deadline's Inside the Ring Episode 1
videos.overview: Deadline Hollywood’s Dominic Patten and Anthony D’Alessandro dive into the highly anticipated first episode of Amazon Prime Video’s The Lord of The Rings: The Rings of Power with special guests Morfydd Clark (Galadriel), Robert Aramayo (Elrond), Ben Walker (Gil-galad), and Charles Edwards (Celebrimbor). Plus, showrunners J.D. Payne & Patrick McKay, and executive producer Lindsey Weber.

videos.title: Deadline's Inside the Ring Episode 2
videos.overview: Deadline Hollywood’s Dominic Patten and Anthony D’Alessandro continue their journey into the depths of the second age of Middle Earth with special guest Sophia Nomvette (Disa), Owain Arthur (Durin IV), Markella Kavenagh (Nori), Megan Richards (Poppy), Daniel Weyman (The Stranger), Sara Zwangobani (Marigold), and Robert Aramayo (Elrond). Plus, showrunners J.D. Payne & Patrick McKay, and executive producer Lindsey Weber.

videos.title: Deadline's Inside the Ring Episode 3
videos.overview: Deadline Hollywood’s Dominic Patten and Anthony D’Alessandro explore the island kingdom of Numenor with special guests Lloyd Owen (Elendil), Morfydd Clark (Galadriel), Charlie Vickers (Halbrand), Cynthia Addai-Robinson (Queen Miriel), Trystan Gravelle (Pharazon), Markella Kavenagh (Nori), Megan Richards (Poppy), Daniel Weyman (The Stranger), Sara Zwangobani (Marigold). Plus, episode director Wayne Che Yip and writer Justin Doble.

videos.title: Deadline's Inside the Ring Episode 4
videos.overview: Deadline Hollywood’s Dominic Patten and Anthony D’Alessandro continue their journey through the second age of Middle-earth! Conflict flares in the Southlands, Galadriel spars with Queen Regent Miriel, and the Dwarves discover a new mineral! With special guests Cynthia Addai-Robinson (Queen Regent Miriel), Trystan Gravelle (Pharazon), Nazanin Boniadi (Bronwyn), and Ismael Cruz Cordova (Arondir). Plus, episode director Wayne Che Yip, writer Justin Doble, and dialect coach Leith McPherson.

videos.title: Deadline's Inside the Ring Episode 5
videos.overview: Deadline Hollywood’s Dominic Patten and Anthony D’Alessandro prepare to set sail from Numenor to war in Middle-earth! With special guests Morfydd Clark (Galadriel), Charlie Vickers (Halbrand), Cynthia Addai-Robinson (Queen Regent Miriel), Trystan Gravelle (Pharazon), Ema Horvath (Earien), and Leon Wadham (Kemen). Plus, episode director Wayne Che Yip, writer Justin Doble, and composer Bear McCreary.

Plus, episode director Charlotte Brandstrom, writer Justin Doble, and composer Bear McCreary.

videos.title: A Shadow of the Past
videos.overview: Galadriel is disturbed by signs of an ancient evil’s return; Arondir makes an unsettling discovery; Elrond is presented with an intriguing new venture; Nori breaks the Harfoot community’s most deeply-held rule.

videos.title: Adrift
videos.overview: Galadriel finds a new ally; Elrond faces a cold reception from an old friend; Nori endeavors to help a Stranger; Arondir searches for answers while Bronwyn warns her people of a threat.

videos.title: Adar
videos.overview: Arondir finds himself a captive. Galadriel and Halbrand explore a legendary kingdom. Elendil is given a new assignment. Nori faces the consequences.

videos.title: The Great Wave
videos.overview: Queen Regent Míriel’s faith is tested. Isildur finds himself at a crossroads. Elrond uncovers a secret. Arondir is given an ultimatum. Theo disobeys Bronwyn.

videos.title: Partings
videos.overview: Nori questions her instincts. Elrond struggles to stay true to his oath. Halbrand weighs his destiny. The Southlanders brace for attack.

videos.title: Udûn
videos.overview: Adar and his army march on Ostirith.

videos.title: The Eye
videos.overview: Survivors of a cataclysm try to find safety. The Harfoots confront evil. Durin is torn between friendship and duty. Adar considers a new name.

videos.title: Alloyed
videos.overview: New alliances are forged.

videos.title: Elven Kings Under the Sky
videos.overview: Sauron bargains with Adar. The Stranger and Nori venture into new lands. The Three Elven Rings face judgment.

videos.title: Where the Stars Are Strange
videos.overview: Darkness falls over Khazad-dûm. Sauron and Galadriel each seek new allies. The Stranger and Harfoots encounter a growing threat.

videos.title: The Eagle and the Sceptre
videos.overview: Isildur and an old friend reunite. Arondir grapples with change. Míriel faces rising opposition. Annatar counsels Celebrimbor.

videos.title: Eldest
videos.overview: The Stranger finds what he's been searching for. Arondir and Isildur search for Theo. Galadriel and Elrond walk into a trap.

videos.title: Halls of Stone
videos.overview: When Durin grows suspicious of the Dwarven Rings, Celebrimbor must reassess his priorities. Amidst Númenor's shifting currents, Elendil searches for hope.

videos.title: Where Is He?
videos.overview: Galadriel considers a proposition. Elendil faces judgment. The Stranger finds himself at a crossroads. Sauron's plans bear fruit.

videos.title: Doomed to Die
videos.overview: Eregion's fate is decided.

videos.title: Shadow and Flame
videos.overview: The free peoples of Middle-earth struggle against the forces of darkness.
